name: Tech Duinn

attributes.attribute: the House of Donn and a site in Irish myth
a small rocky island off the Beara Peninsula in west County Cork
a frightening place of darkness and dread, unlike other views of the Otherworld

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tech Duinn is the House of Donn in Irish myth. It is a small rocky island off the Beara peninsula in west County Cork. People believed it was the home of Donn. Donn is a shadowy early god. He ruled the Otherworld of death. Later views show the Otherworld as a beautiful land. Tech Duinn was not like that. It was a place of darkness and dread. Its link to the usual Otherworld is unclear.

okr.objective: Describe Tech Duinn, the House of Donn in Irish myth.
key_results: Tech Duinn is a small rocky island off the Beara Peninsula in west County Cork.
It was the home of Donn, an early god tied to the Otherworld of death.
It was a dark and frightening place, unlike other visions of the Otherworld.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
